In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 3. Certificate of incorporation & PO Copy from an y Govt Dept/agency to be enclosed. 8. The OEM of the CCTV camera must have more than 300 employees on its payroll in India. This i s to justify that CCTV OEM has made investment in India and is seriou s about its business in India which wil l ensure long term after sales support and spare support from the OE M.
